name: RaMa-Scene Explorer
description: A static, map-first explorer of the greenhouse-gas emissions, jobs and metal-ore extraction embodied in each country's final demand, split by 15 industry sections, over precomputed RaMa-Scene engine runs on EXIOBASE v3.3.sm (base year 2011): the baseline, three named interventions and 150 material-efficiency scenarios. Flows are drawn on a flat map or a globe, and What if… shows how each run changes them. Every precomputed number comes from a verified engine run, with its provenance and checks on the same page. An optional live mode sends a custom scenario to the RaMa-Scene job API and shows its result, marked as not checked. Releases carry build provenance. Nothing is a forecast.
